lines.en: Mine mud sticks to my feet.
My pick is still in hand.
Cave light beats sunlight.
My pick still hangs at my belt.
The tunnel's low; I duck as I walk.

lines.zh: 矿道里没有风，只有滴水。
lines.en: No wind here, only dripping.
Each step, my boot sole sticks.
My footsteps come back twice.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的靴尖走路。
lines.en: I walk staring at the toes of my boots.
My shadow leaves the shaft before I do.
My knee clicks with every step.
The rail has rusted red.
Underground there are no hours.
My hard hat is still on.

lines.zh: 矿灯早灭了，眼里全是沙。
lines.en: My lamp died long ago; sand fills my eyes.
Counting my ribs, two are missing.
The lamp's out and I can still walk.
I seem to have forgotten something important.
Why am I still holding a petal?

lines.zh: 发光浆果在我口袋里发光。
lines.en: Glow berries glow in my pocket.
A layer of coal dust settles on my helmet brim.

lines.zh: 这镐我举了太久，站着也行。
lines.en: I've held this pick too long; standing is fine.
My pick lies under your feet.
Your hands are still warm. Lend me that.
The lamp smoke ruined my eyes.
If you leave, I have only the tunnels again.

lines.zh: 我听见你血管里的声音。
lines.en: I hear the sound inside your veins.
My stomach rotted away long ago.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，盖过煤灰。
lines.en: Your scent drowns out the coal dust.

lines.zh: 这具骨架记得热的样子。
lines.en: These bones remember what warm felt like.

lines.zh: 你的影子在矿壁上很长。
lines.en: Your shadow runs long on the tunnel wall.
They call me Miner Zombie. Remember.
One more step and I swing the pick.

lines.zh: 这一镐砸下去，我自己也晃。
lines.en: One swing of this pick and I stagger too.

lines.zh: 镐从我的手里掉下去了。
lines.en: My pick has fallen out of my hand.
I have set my shoulder back in place.

lines.zh: 铁镐柄上的手印，是我的。
lines.en: The handprint on this pick handle is mine.
I pick the pick up with my wrist.
The broken rib grates against my skin.

lines.zh: 这身烂肉挡不住第二下。
lines.en: This rotting flesh will not take a second blow.
I can still stand. Do not rush.
Wounds hurt less once you are dead.
Down here, anything smells good.
Do not put that meat away.
I am gritting my teeth; you cannot see it.

lines.zh: 地下的光，是从浆果来的。
lines.en: The light down here comes from the berries.

lines.zh: 我手里的铁镐，还认得矿脉。
lines.en: This iron pick still knows a vein.
This iron pick suits my hand.
My empty belly has been shouting for a year.

lines.zh: 你放地上，我数三下就收。
lines.en: Set it down; I count to three and take it.

lines.zh: 吃过发光浆果，我就认你的矿灯。
lines.en: Once I eat glow berries, I follow your lamp.

lines.zh: 发光的果子，让我再瞧一会儿。
lines.en: That glowing berry — let me look longer.
Back off; the mine lamp stings my eyes.
You knock my mine lamp swinging.
Too long underground; even light scares me.
A zombie under the mine, gripping an iron pick.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀顶到我的镐柄。
lines.en: Your shoulder jars the haft of my pick.
My shoulder joint nearly slipped apart.

lines.zh: 这味道有汗，有铁，没有土。
lines.en: It smells of sweat and iron, not earth.
Why is a living body this warm?
My mining helmet has been knocked askew.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨撞上去，响了一声。
lines.en: My ribs hit it and rang once.

lines.zh: 发光浆果的光，照着我们俩。
lines.en: Glow berries light the two of us.

lines.zh: 矿道尽头，正好两个人宽。
lines.en: At the shaft's end, there is room for two.
My finger bones come apart when I let go.
I clutch an iron pick in my hand.
The flesh on my fingers is long gone.
You could not stand my smell.
I cannot even muster a heartbeat.
The shaft caved in. Still I don't leave.
Are you cold? I went numb long ago.
Next life, I will remember to bring a lamp.
This stone is flecked with coal.

lines.zh: 矿里的金锭，我替自己留一块。
lines.en: I keep one gold ingot from the shaft for myself.
I clamp both hands around it like a lump of coal.
Whatever falls in the tunnel is mine.
This flower does not belong in a mine.
This iron could buy a new pick.
The lamp went out. I dig anyway.
If my fingers wedge it, it will not fall.
I stuff it under a railway sleeper.

lines.zh: 矿道里翻出来的旧东西。
lines.en: An old thing dug out of the mine shaft.
The point of my pick comes up.
Move, and I will knock your torch down.
This lamp has found you.
I follow slowly. No hurry.
Turning back won't help; the shaft is blocked.
Your sweat drips onto the coal dust.
The tunnel is long and time is plenty.
Thump, thump, rattling through the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我把矿灯转向你的方向。
lines.en: I turn my lamp toward you.
The lamp underground is mine.
At the tunnel's end, only you.
I have not smelled this in a long time.
Living folk should not enter this seam.

lines.zh: 我背着把铁镐，走得很慢。
lines.en: I carry an iron pick and walk slow.
Even rotten teeth want a bite.
From this tunnel to the next.

lines.zh: 我的镐还在背上，可惜砍不动了。
lines.en: My pick is still on my back — it just won't swing.
This tunnel opens only one way.
You hold a torch, and I'm not moving.
I hear the gravel you kick loose.
I drag my pick along with me.

lines.zh: 矿道我走了无数遍，闭眼都行。
lines.en: I've walked these shafts so often I could do it blind.

lines.zh: 矿灯照到你，你已经输了。
lines.en: The mine lamp finds you — you've lost.

lines.zh: 矿灯晃着，你的影子带我走。
lines.en: The lamp sways; your shadow leads me.

lines.zh: 你的火把能借我看看吗。
lines.en: May I borrow your torch to see?
My pick point is nearly at you.
I stagger, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 汗味在矿壁上一层层叠。
lines.en: Your sweat layers on the rock.
These legs do not tire; they only break.
The more your breath races, the steadier I am.
Can't swing a pick. I can still bite.

lines.zh: 你的每一步，都落在我的矿道。
lines.en: Every step of yours lands on my tunnel.
I have even given up a heartbeat.
That one landed with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我镐子还没钝。
lines.en: One more hit; my pick is not dull yet.
My pick comes down — one sharp clack.

lines.zh: 发光浆果在我兜里挤烂了。
lines.en: Glow berries squashed in my pocket.

lines.zh: 这手臂只剩挥镐的力气。
lines.en: This arm only remembers the pick.
My pick swung wide. Sorry.
The first blow in this tunnel is yours.

lines.zh: 发光浆果照着我这张脸。
lines.en: Glow berries light this face.
I bring the pick down on your knee.
This one is just enough to put you down.
I cannot stop this hand.

lines.zh: 我的骨头手扣住你衣领。
lines.en: My bony hand hooks your collar.
I sweep the haft of my pick across.
The echo will bring others.
You have backed into the support beam.
The pick falls first; I apologize after.

lines.zh: 从矿洞爬出来，活人别靠近。
lines.en: Out of the shaft — living ones, stay back.
I crawl out from under the sleepers.
Up, and stay steady.
I died here, halfway through digging.

lines.zh: 这矿道里，只我一副骨头。
lines.en: Only my bones are in this tunnel.

lines.zh: 从矿洞往上爬，天亮还早。
lines.en: Climbing out of the shaft — dawn is far.
The cave-in pushed the dirt aside.

lines.zh: 土松了，我从矿洞里爬出来。
lines.en: The soil's loose — I'm crawling out of the mine.

lines.zh: 我又闻到了矿井的味道。
lines.en: I smell the mine again.
My eyes fear light. Take it slowly.
It's always dark in the shaft; no need to wait.
Coal dust settles over my helmet.
The pick in my hand is iron.
First I check the pick at my belt.
Fire burns my sleeve to ash.

lines.zh: 我落地时，骨头响成一片。
lines.en: When I land, my bones rattle all at once.

lines.zh: 矿井灌满水，骨头泡得发沉。
lines.en: The shaft flooded; my bones feel waterlogged.
The blast buries me in a heap of coal.

lines.zh: 箭头卡死在我的肩胛里。
lines.en: The arrowhead is wedged in my shoulder blade.
Spell-light crawls along the seams of my bones.
Hungry — hungrier than usual.

lines.zh: 雷灌进我的镐，手还举着。
lines.en: The lightning ran down my pick; my hand still holds it.
There is no tunnel below, only black.
